mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive in >40% of cases when FEDFUNDS >4.5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, which spills over into the broader economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when HOUST is above its 5-year average, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when UNRATE is below 4%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is low and the federal funds rate is high, it indicates conflicting economic conditions, leading to increased market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are positive in >40% of cases when UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS is high, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when INDPRO is growing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High retail and food services sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when RSAFS is high, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP is growing and the unemployment rate is low, it indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when GDPC1 is growing and UNRATE is low, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If S&P 500 returns are negative when PAYEMS is increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.
